stem:
Nitin notices it is daytime where he is, while it is night in another place on Earth at the same time.

What causes day and night?

options.text: Earth's rotation moves each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
Earth orbits the Sun once each year.
It is daytime everywhere on Earth at the same time.
The Moon blocks the Sun each evening.

teacher.key_rationale: Day and night happen because rotation turns each place toward and away from the Sun. Yearly orbit is a different mechanism. Daytime is not the same everywhere at once.
